title: san-miguel - converted from OBJ
description: Converted from san-miguel.obj by scripts/obj-to-ply.fsx: 9,980,699 triangles across 287 material groups. Materials carry OBJ diffuse and specular; textures are not transferred. 1 groups use an alpha map (cut-out foliage or grilles) which this renderer has no alpha test for, so those surfaces render as solid geometry.
